verdict.rationale: AvaTax is an API-based calculation service that says it applies jurisdiction-aware logic reflecting current tax rules and boundaries, supports temporary tax changes without custom rule engines, and serves real-time rates for 200+ countries and jurisdictions. This implies the vendor maintains rate and rule content server-side, so customers would not redeploy. However, the evidence never explicitly describes an automatic update process or a change log of effective dates. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the vendor-managed rate/rule update process, published effective-date documentation or change notifications for rule changes, and independent corroboration that updates land without customer action.
